turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's grade changed before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Who decided it, and what was it based on?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What did you base the zero on?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
I'm not a witness, Hale. What do you have?
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
I'm not answering that. Is there a document?
You're not answering. Why not?
Because you're the one with a case to make. Show me something with a date on it.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
Are you accusing me of something, Hale? Say it plainly, or show me a document.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
Owen says he wrote it, and I believe my son. Now, what do you have?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Same answer. I'm not the one being questioned, and I'm done being asked. Show me something, or I'm going to the principal.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. A student can type up notes he already had. Turn the screen around.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
I'm not the one being questioned. Procedure says you speak to Owen first. Did you?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written guarantee about his record; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got it on the table.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one plain sentence, and she gave a flat okay and a little ground, because it took away her easiest complaint.
What cost ground: You spent most of the meeting pressing her about what she saw at home that night, which she treated as a witness being questioned, so she dug in before you showed her a single document.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, watched Owen close it, and never asked; your questions about that night and the late-night times in your version history came very close to it, but that proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with the version history, turn the screen, say the date and what the times show, and then offer 4.4 instead of asking her what she saw at home.
